Distillate CI fixture

This page exists so the container job can prove one thing the unit tests cannot: that the image, started exactly as documented, can drive a real browser, fetch a page it has never seen and return reader-view output.

It is deliberately dull. A fixture with a paywall, a cookie wall or a consent dialog would make the test a statement about that website rather than about the container.

If this text appears in the response body, the pipeline from HTTP request to Chromium to SmartReader to markdown is intact.
